therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Immunocytokine targeting GD2 ganglioside with IL-2 fusion for immune activation
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Anti-tumor immune response via GD2-targeted IL-2 delivery
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Resectable recurrent stage III or stage IV melanoma
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Recurrence Free Survival and Overall Survival

results.effect_size: Median RFS: 5.73 months, Median OS: 61.57 months
results.target_engagement_evidence: GD2 expression detected in 6/12 evaluable patients (3 positive in each arm)
biomarker_changes: CRP increased from baseline 0 mg/dL to 9-11 mg/dL at cycle 1 day 3
Lymphocyte count decreased from baseline ~1600 to 200-250 at cycle 1 day 3, then rebounded to ~4000-4900 at cycle 1 day 8
Soluble IL-2 receptor alpha increased from baseline ~1260 ng/ml to peak ~10800-12400 ng/ml at cycle days 4
subgroup_findings: GD2 positive patients: 3/11 in arm A, 3/9 in arm B
GD2 negative patients: 3/11 in arm A, 3/9 in arm B
safety_signals: Lymphopenia was a serious adverse event in both arms
Headache and vomiting reported in arm A
Infection and neuropathy reported in other arms

context.indication: resectable recurrent stage III or stage IV melanoma
context.comparator: different timing of surgery relative to hu14.18-IL2 treatment
